desc:
🌾 Build the biggest Farm! Your crops keep growing even while you're offline!

🎲 Roll for Rare Farmers, from Carrot Farmers to 1-in-a-Million Secrets!
🚜 Your Farmers plant and grow crops for you
🥕 Harvest your crops and sell them for cash
✨ Unlock rarer, stronger Farmers
🏡 Expand your farm and grow even more

🎃 Halloween Event ends Oct 31

👍 Like the game and join the group for +50% Luck!
💬 Found a bug or have an idea? Leave feedback, we read it all!
